**Ludora - the Client for all Game Clients** · Release 0.7.2

### What's new
- **Only games that run on your system:** by default the library now hides owned games that don't run on your operating system – Windows, macOS or Linux (on Linux, Windows games via Proton/Wine count as playable; only games Steam rates as unsupported, usually because of anti-cheat, are hidden). Toggle it with **“Runs on …”** above the library; when it's off, unsuitable games are marked “Not for macOS” etc. Platform data comes from Steam, GOG and Epic and is cached for 30 days.
- **Stream from your other devices:** Steam games that aren't installed here but are installed on another of your devices signed in to Steam (PC, laptop, Steam Deck) show the device name and a **Stream** button (Steam Remote Play). Requires being signed in to Steam in Ludora's friends panel.

### Downloads
| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | `Ludora-Setup-0.7.2.exe` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon M1–M4) | `Ludora-0.7.2-arm64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
| macOS (Intel) | `Ludora-0.7.2-x64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
| Linux (any distribution) | `Ludora-0.7.2-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Debian / Ubuntu | `Ludora-0.7.2-amd64.deb` |

The files are not code-signed: on Windows click **More info → Run anyway**, on macOS **right-click → Open** on the first start.
[Installation](https://github.com/MaxiMagDich93/ludora#installation) · [Anleitung auf Deutsch](https://github.com/MaxiMagDich93/ludora/blob/main/README.de.md#installation)

---

**Deutsch:** Die Bibliothek zeigt standardmäßig nur Spiele, die auf deinem Betriebssystem laufen (Umschalter „Läuft auf …“; unter Linux zählen Proton/Wine mit). Steam-Spiele, die auf einem anderen deiner Geräte installiert sind, lassen sich per **Streamen**-Knopf über Steam Remote Play spielen.
